title: Polling Latent Opinions: A Method for Computational Sociolinguistics Using Transformer Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of generated star ratings from a pre-trained GPT-2 model against ground truth Yelp data to identify an inherent skew toward generating positive (4-star) reviews.

Using prompt-based queries (e.g., phrasing related to 'vegetarian options') and the Flair sentiment analysis API to evaluate how finetuned models reproduce the specific sentiment distributions and latent opinions of the training population.
